name: Warding Figure: Silver Swallow, Evil-Bane
description: A Warding Figure modeled after Lan Yan. Its intricate yet adorable design houses a mechanical core powered by an arcane technique, capable of gathering and sealing away stray evil spirit.\n"I heard that whenever a big bad evil spirit appears, these smaller clumps start popping up too, causing trouble everywhere." With this in mind, its creator wove this Warding Figure to deal with the weaker, scattered fragments of evil spirit...\nSolving a whole lot of tiny problems that go unnoticed can be just as good as solving one big one.
